content.overview: Section 179 vests general management in the board, exercisable only by resolutions at meetings for the matters listed, and s. 180 reserves stated powers to the general meeting.
content.glance: Section 179 vests general management in the board, exercisable only by resolutions at meetings for the matters listed, and s. 180 reserves stated powers to the general meeting.
content.study: The board may do what the company is authorised to do, subject to the Act, memorandum and articles. Certain powers, including borrowing beyond paid-up capital and free reserves, selling an undertaking, and investing compensation amounts, need a special resolution under s. 180. Contributions to charitable funds are limited by s. 181. Political contributions are s. 182. Related-party contracts are s. 188.
